DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic Jaundice of the Late Onset).

The rapid progression of jaundice to the trunk in a well-appearing, exclusively breastfed infant at 5 days of age, combined with normal stooling, is classic for this condition. The requested blood work will confirm elevated unconjugated bilirubin levels, but the clinical picture strongly points to inadequate intake rather than pathology like hemolysis. Please continue feeding frequently to promote weight gain and stooling, which will help lower bilirubin levels naturally.
